title: 第十九章 沙碛决生死孤剑定乾坤第二十章西风携秘事孤影赴新程
content_zh:
朔风卷地，黄沙漫天，将苍茫沙碛磨成一片混沌的黄。天地间唯有一道挺拔的身影，玄甲染血，孤剑拄地，肩背如劲松般不肯弯折。他便是萧琰，大梁七皇子，被朝堂放逐十二年的靖王，亦是沙碛之上，以孤勇赴生死、以初心定乾坤的铁血男儿。“沙碛决生死，孤剑定乾坤”，这十字不仅是他半生征战的写照，更是他骨血里的执念与担当——以一身孤勇踏破漫天黄沙，以一柄长剑昭雪万千冤魂，以一颗赤子之心，撑起大梁摇摇欲坠的江山。
萧琰的半生，是从云端跌落尘泥，再从沙碛中浴血重生的半生。年少时，他是天之骄子，生于帝王家，却无半分纨绔气。母亲静妃出身林府医女，自幼教他宽厚仁善；祁王兄风骨凛然，引他明辨是非、心怀黎庶；挚友林殊鲜衣怒马，与他并肩策马、共赴沙场。那时的他，眼中有光，心中有义，一身少年意气，驰骋于金陵城外的演武场，以为凭一腔热血便能护家国安宁，凭一身坦荡便能守兄弟情深。他承袭了祁王的贤明，兼具林燮将军的刚毅，与那些养尊处优、醉心权谋的皇子们截然不同，眉宇间的英气与坦荡，是他最鲜明的印记。
变故陡生，梅岭火光冲天，七万赤焰军蒙冤惨死，祁王被赐鸩酒，林家满门被灭。一夜之间，他所信奉的一切轰然崩塌，那些并肩同行的情谊、坚定不移的正义，皆成了刻在骨血里的伤痕。满朝文武皆避之不及，唯有萧琰，不顾梁帝的震怒与冷落，屡次在朝堂之上直言进谏，为祁王鸣冤，为赤焰军辩白。他的刚直不阿，在波诡云谲的朝堂上显得格格不入；他的执着坚守，成了梁帝眼中最刺眼的叛逆。于是，他被放逐于朝堂之外，远离金陵的权力中心，奉旨四处征战，辗转于边关沙碛之上，一去便是十二年。
这十二年，沙碛成了他的居所，孤剑成了他的知己，生死成了他的日常。边关的风是烈的，吹得他皮肤粗糙、眉眼沧桑，却吹不散他眼底的执念；沙碛的沙是寒的，磨得他铠甲斑驳、剑刃残缺，却磨不灭他心中的赤诚。他常年带兵征战，体恤将士，与士兵们同甘共苦、同生共死，在铁血硝烟的熏陶下，身上的刚毅之气愈发浓烈，军中人皆敬他、服他，称他为“靖王将军”。他战功累累，平定边境叛乱，抵御外敌入侵，每一场战役都身先士卒，每一次冲锋都毫无惧色，可即便如此，他依旧得不到梁帝的封赏，依旧是那个被朝堂遗忘的边缘皇子。
沙碛之上的生死对决，从来都不止于敌我之间的厮杀，更在于萧琰与自己的较量——较量着对冤屈的隐忍，较量着对情谊的坚守，较量着在黑暗中寻找光明的勇气。有一次，他率军驻守北境沙碛，遭遇敌军突袭，兵力悬殊，粮草断绝。敌军主帅派人劝降，许他高官厚禄，许他荣华富贵，告诉他，只要他低头归顺，便不必再困于这黄沙漫天的边关，不必再为那些冤死的人白白牺牲。萧琰站在城楼上，望着下方黑压压的敌军，望着身边疲惫不堪却依旧眼神坚定的将士，缓缓拔出了腰间的孤剑。
剑刃在烈日下折射出冷冽的寒光，一如他此刻的眼神，冰冷而决绝。“我萧琰，生为大梁人，死为大梁鬼，可杀，不可辱！”他的声音穿透风沙，掷地有声，“赤焰军蒙冤，祁王兄含恨，我今日守在这里，守的不仅是大梁的疆土，更是心中的公道，是万千忠魂的期盼！”话音未落，他便策马提剑，孤身冲入敌阵。孤剑翻飞，寒光闪烁，每一剑都直指要害，每一次挥剑都凝聚着他的悲愤与执念。黄沙被鲜血染红，铠甲上的血痂层层叠加，他的手臂被砍伤，肩膀被箭射穿，却依旧不肯后退一步。将士们见靖王如此孤勇，皆热血沸腾，紧随其后，奋勇杀敌，最终以少胜多，击退了敌军，守住了边关重镇。
那场战役，萧琰在沙碛中浴血奋战了整整一日一夜，当最后一名敌军倒下时，他拄着孤剑，单膝跪地，大口大口地喘着粗气，视线渐渐模糊。风沙掠过他的脸颊，带走了脸上的汗水与血水，却带不走他眼底的坚定。他望着漫天黄沙，仿佛看到了梅岭的火光，看到了祁王兄温柔的眉眼，看到了林殊笑着向他跑来的身影。那一刻，他忽然明白，沙碛之上的每一次生死对决，都是在为昭雪冤屈积蓄力量；手中的每一寸剑刃，都是在为守护公道磨砺锋芒。“沙碛决生死”，这生死之间，藏着他的隐忍与坚守，藏着他的孤勇与担当，藏着他对万千忠魂的承诺。
十二年的沙碛征战，不仅磨砺了他的意志，更让他积淀了实力，收获了民心。那些养在深宫、只会权谋内斗的太子与誉王，永远不懂沙碛的残酷，不懂将士的疾苦，更不懂民心的可贵。而萧琰，在十二年的辗转中，见过边关百姓流离失所的苦难，见过将士们浴血奋战的悲壮，见过沙碛之上生离死别的决绝，他的心，渐渐从对个人情谊的执念，转向了对天下苍生的担当。他不再仅仅是那个为兄弟鸣冤的皇子，更是那个心怀黎庶、志在安邦的将军；他手中的孤剑，不再仅仅是复仇的利器，更是守护家国、安定乾坤的象征。
梅长苏的出现，是萧琰命运的转折点，更是他从“武将萧琰”向“帝王萧琰”蜕变的开端。当那个病弱不堪、智谋无双的谋士出现在他面前，提出要辅佐他夺嫡时，萧琰笑了，那笑容里，有对自己的不自信，有对朝堂的失望，更有对梅长苏的戒备。他厌恶朝堂的尔虞我诈，不屑权谋的阴诡算计，即便他渴望昭雪冤屈，渴望为兄弟讨回公道，也不愿用那些卑劣的手段。于是，他与梅长苏的关系，在怀疑与试探中反复拉锯——他既想要借助梅长苏的智谋，又反感他的步步算计；他既感激梅长苏的相助，又警惕他的目的。
霓凰郡主被越贵妃设计陷害时，他第一时间怀疑是梅长苏布局，怒而斥责梅长苏不懂军旅热血，强硬要求对方定下不得伤害忠良的规矩；卫峥事件中，他误信谗言，认定梅长苏为成大事不惜牺牲赤焰旧部，竟一剑斩断代表彼此信任的宫铃，怒斥梅长苏没有天性和良知，全然不顾重病在身的梅长苏的哀求。这份轴与犟，这份不被权力腐蚀的纯粹，正是他区别于其他皇子的特质，也是梅长苏所看重的初心。可他终究不懂，在这波诡云谲的朝堂之上，一味孤勇换不来公道，唯有手握权力，才能拨乱反正，才能为赤焰军昭雪冤屈。
九安山之变，成了萧琰彻底醒悟的契机。誉王叛乱，猎宫被围，生死一线之际，萧琰成功拿到兵符，率军驰援。他依旧是那个身先士卒的将军，依旧是那个孤勇无畏的男儿，手中的孤剑再次出鞘，在乱军之中奋勇拼杀，护得梁帝与众人的安全。平定叛乱后，他没有丝毫犹豫，第一时间将兵符交还梁帝，这份坦荡，让向来多疑的梁帝都为之迟疑。而更让他震撼的是，在这场叛乱中，他终于确认，眼前这个病弱不堪的谋士，正是自己思念了十二年的挚友——林殊。
那一刻，这个铮铮铁骨的汉子彻底崩溃了。他回到芷萝宫，跪倒在母亲静妃膝下，痛哭流涕：“我就快认出他了，我应该认出他来的。”他心疼林殊十二年来所受的煎熬，心疼他从鲜衣怒马的少年将军，变成了病弱缠身的谋士；他深深愧疚于自己曾经的误解，愧疚于自己一次次的斥责与伤害。这份迟来的相认，让他心中的执念得以释怀，也让他彻底读懂了梅长苏的步步为营——那些看似冰冷的算计，从来不是为了权位，而是为了赤焰的万千冤魂，为了大梁的万里河山。
从此，萧琰不再是孤身一人。他与梅长苏并肩作战，将个人情感融入昭雪冤案、重振朝纲的大业之中。他放下了对“算计”的偏见，学会了权衡利弊，学会了隐忍克制，他不再是那个只会拼杀的武将，而是渐渐成长为一个心怀天下、运筹帷幄的储君。他招揽贤才，重用沈追、蔡荃等贤能之士，整饬朝纲，改革弊政；他安抚民心，减免赋税，体恤百姓疾苦，让流离失所的百姓得以安居乐业；他整顿军纪，重编长林军，让大梁的军队重新焕发活力，守护着边境的安宁。
朝堂之上，他与夏江、谢玉等奸佞之臣正面交锋，手中的“孤剑”，不再是沙碛之上的利刃，而是公道与正义的象征。他以十二年沙碛征战练就的坚韧与果敢，以梅长苏传授的智谋与策略，层层揭开悬镜司的阴谋，一步步揭露赤焰冤案的真相，让那些作恶多端的奸佞之臣，皆得到了应有的惩罚。他不畏皇权，不惧威胁，哪怕面对梁帝的震怒与阻挠，也始终坚守初心，不肯退让半步——他要为祁王兄昭雪，要为七万赤焰军昭雪，要为天下人守住一个清明的朝堂。
寿宴之上，萧琰与梅长苏联手，借莅阳长公主之手，当众揭开了赤焰冤案的全部真相。当那份尘封了十二年的罪证公之于众，当七万赤焰军的冤屈得以昭雪，当祁王兄的清白得以证明，朝堂之上一片哗然，百姓们痛哭流涕，感恩不已。那一刻，萧琰站在朝堂之上，身姿挺拔，目光坚定，他终于完成了自己十二年的执念，终于告慰了万千忠魂的在天之灵。而他，也彻底赢得了朝堂上下的认可，成为了民心所向、众望所归的储君。
不久之后，梁帝退位，萧琰登基为帝，史称武靖帝。登基之日，他身着龙袍，头戴皇冠，站在太和殿的顶端，望着下方跪拜的群臣，望着万里江山，心中没有丝毫的喜悦，只有沉甸甸的责任。他想起了沙碛之上的生死对决，想起了梅长苏的深情厚谊，想起了祁王兄的殷切期望，想起了七万赤焰军的冤屈，想起了边关百姓的疾苦。他知道，自己肩上的担子，比以往任何时候都要沉重——他要守住这万里江山，要完成梅长苏与祁王兄未竟的心愿，要让大梁变得繁荣昌盛，要让天下百姓都能安居乐业。
登基之后，萧琰励精图治，勤政爱民。他沿用祁王的治国理念，改革弊政，整顿吏治，重用贤能，严惩奸佞；他加强边防，重编长林军，任用蒙挚、卫峥等忠勇之士，守护着大梁的边境安宁，让沙碛之上再无战火纷飞，让边境百姓得以安居乐业；他体恤民情，减免赋税，兴修水利，鼓励农耕，让大梁的国力日渐强盛，百姓的生活日渐富足。他始终记得自己在沙碛之上的誓言，始终记得自己的初心，始终以一颗赤子之心，对待天下百姓，对待自己的江山。
岁月流转，当年沙碛之上的铁血将军，如今已成了一代贤明帝王。他的眉眼间，少了几分少年意气，多了几分帝王的沉稳与担当；少了几分悲愤与执念，多了几分宽厚与从容。可他心中的那份孤勇与赤诚，却从未改变；他手中的“孤剑”，依旧是守护公道、安定乾坤的象征——只是这柄剑，不再沾染鲜血，而是化作了治国安邦的良方，化作了守护百姓的屏障。
朔风依旧，黄沙依旧，只是沙碛之上，再无当年的生死厮杀，只剩一片安宁与祥和。萧琰偶尔会独自一人，来到边关沙碛，拄着一柄长剑，望着漫天黄沙，望着万里江山。他仿佛又看到了当年那个浴血奋战的自己，看到了梅长苏笑着向他走来，看到了祁王兄温柔的眉眼，看到了七万赤焰军整齐的队列。那一刻，他终于明白，“沙碛决生死，孤剑定乾坤”，从来都不是一句口号，而是他半生的写照，是他一生的坚守。
他以沙碛为磨砺，以生死为考验，以孤剑为支撑，以赤子为初心，从一个被放逐的皇子，成长为一代贤明帝王；从守护一份情谊，到守护万里江山；从昭雪一桩冤屈，到安定一个乾坤。萧琰的一生，是孤勇的一生，是坚守的一生，是担当的一生。他用自己的一生，诠释了何为“赤子之心”，何为“家国情怀”，何为“沙碛决生死，孤剑定乾坤”。

千百年后，当人们谈起大梁的贤明帝王，谈起那段波澜壮阔的历史，总会想起那个站在沙碛之上，孤剑拄地，一身赤胆忠心的男儿——萧琰。他的故事，会像沙碛之上的星光，永远闪耀；他的精神，会像边关的长风，永远流传；他的初心，会像手中的孤剑，永远坚定。沙碛无言，见证了他的生死与坚守；岁月无声，铭记了他的担当与传奇。萧琰，以孤勇赴使命，以铁血定江山，不负韶华，不负初心，不负天下，不负万千忠魂，终成一代传奇，永载史册。

content_en:
The shuo wind swept over the ground and filled the sky with yellow sand, grinding the vast sand moraine into a chaotic yellow. There is only one tall figure between heaven and earth, with black armor stained with blood, a lone sword leaning on the ground, and shoulders that refuse to bend like strong pine trees. He is Xiao Yan, the seventh prince of Liang Dynasty, Prince Jing who has been exiled by the court for twelve years. He is also an iron-blooded man who bravely faces life and death alone on the sand ridge and determines the world with his original intention. "Sha Qi determines life and death, and a solitary sword determines the world." This cross is not only a portrayal of his half-life battle, but also the obsession and responsibility in his bones and blood - stepping through the yellow sand in the sky with a single bravery, using a long sword to avenge thousands of wronged souls, and using an innocent heart to prop up the crumbling country.
Xiao Yan's half-life was a half-life of falling from the clouds to dust and then reborn from the blood in the sand. When he was young, he was the proud son of heaven, born into an imperial family, but he was not a bit dandy. His mother, Concubine Jing, was a medical doctor in the Lin family, and taught him to be generous and kind since he was a child; his brother, King Qi, had a formidable character, which led him to distinguish right from wrong and to care about common people; his best friend, Lin Shu, dressed in bright clothes and angry with his horse, rode with him on the battlefield together. At that time, he had light in his eyes, righteousness in his heart, and the spirit of a young man, galloping around the martial arts field outside Jinling City, thinking that he could protect the peace of his family and country with his passion, and that he could protect the brotherhood with his magnanimity. He inherited the wisdom of King Qi and the fortitude of General Lin Xie. He was completely different from the princes who were pampered and obsessed with power. The heroism and magnanimity between his brows were his most distinctive mark.
Suddenly, something unexpected happened, Mei Ling burned into the sky, 70,000 Red Flame troops died unjustly, King Qi was given poisonous wine, and the entire Lin family was wiped out. Overnight, everything he believed in collapsed, and the friendship and unwavering justice that he had walked side by side became scars engraved in his bones and blood. All civil and military officials in the dynasty tried to avoid him, but Xiao Yan, regardless of Emperor Liang's anger and neglect, spoke out and remonstrated many times in the court, avowing the injustice of King Qi and defending the Red Flame Army. His uprightness seemed out of place in the turbulent court; his persistence became the most dazzling rebellion in the eyes of Emperor Liang. As a result, he was exiled from the court, far away from the center of power in Jinling. He was ordered to fight everywhere and wandered on the border sand moraine for twelve years.
In these twelve years, Shaqi became his residence, Gujian became his confidant, and life and death became his daily life. The wind at the border was strong, making his skin rough and his features vicissitudes, but it could not dissipate the obsession in his eyes; the sand in Shaqi was cold, making his armor mottled and his sword blade incomplete, but it could not erase the sincerity in his heart. He led troops in battles all year round, showed sympathy to the soldiers, and shared joys and sorrows, life and death with the soldiers. Under the influence of the iron blood and gunpowder smoke, his fortitude became stronger and stronger. Everyone in the army respected and obeyed him, calling him "General Jing Wang". He had many military exploits, quelling border rebellions and resisting foreign invasions. He took the lead in every battle and showed no fear in every charge. But even so, he still did not receive a reward from Emperor Liang, and he was still the marginalized prince forgotten by the court.
The life-and-death duel on the sand moraine has always been more than a fight between the enemy and ourselves, but also a battle between Xiao Yan and himself - a battle of tolerance for injustice, a battle of persistence in friendship, and a battle of courage to find light in the darkness. On one occasion, he led his troops to garrison in Shaqiu in the north, and encountered an enemy attack. The strength of the troops was greatly disparity, and food and grass were cut off. The enemy commander sent someone to persuade him to surrender, promising him a high official position, a generous salary, and glory and wealth. He told him that as long as he bowed his head and surrendered, he would no longer have to be trapped in this sandy border, and he would no longer have to sacrifice in vain for those who died unjustly. Xiao Yan stood on the tower, looking at the dark enemy troops below, looking at the exhausted but still determined-looking soldiers around him, and slowly pulled out the lone sword from his waist.
The blade of the sword reflected a cold light under the scorching sun, just like his eyes at this moment, cold and decisive. "I, Xiao Yan, was born as a Daliang man and died as a Daliang ghost. I can be killed but not humiliated!" His voice penetrated the wind and sand, and was loud and loud, "The Red Flame Army was wronged, and Brother Qi Wang held hatred., I am guarding here today, not only guarding the territory of Daliang, but also the justice in my heart, the hope of thousands of loyal souls! " Before he finished speaking, he rode his horse, raised his sword, and rushed into the enemy formation alone. The sword flew with cold light, and each sword was pointed directly at the vital point. Every swing of the sword condensed his grief, anger and obsession. The yellow sand was dyed red with blood, and the blood scabs on the armor were layered on top of each other. , his arm was cut and his shoulder was shot by an arrow, but he still refused to take a step back. The soldiers were all excited when they saw King Jing being so lonely. They followed him and fought bravely to kill the enemy. In the end, they defeated the enemy with less and defended the important border town.
In that battle, Xiao Yan fought bloody battles in the sand moraine for a whole day and night. When the last enemy soldier fell, he knelt on one knee holding his lone sword, breathing heavily, and his vision gradually blurred. The wind and sand swept over his face, taking away the sweat and blood on his face, but it couldn't take away the determination in his eyes. He looked at the yellow sand in the sky, and seemed to see the firelight of Meiling, the gentle eyebrows of Brother Qi Wang, and Lin Shu's figure running towards him with a smile. At that moment, he suddenly understood that every life-and-death duel on the sand moraine was accumulating strength to avenge injustice; every inch of the sword in his hand was sharpening his edge to protect justice. "Sha Qi determines life and death." Between life and death, there is hidden his forbearance and perseverance, his courage and responsibility, and his promise to thousands of loyal souls.
Twelve years of fighting in the sand moraine not only sharpened his will, but also allowed him to accumulate strength and win the hearts of the people. Those princes and princes who were raised in deep palaces and only knew how to strategize and fight among themselves would never understand the cruelty of Shaqi, the suffering of soldiers, and the value of the people's hearts. And Xiao Yan, in the past twelve years, has seen the suffering of the people at the border who were displaced, the tragic and tragic battles of the soldiers, and the decisive separation of life and death on the sand moraine. His heart gradually shifted from his obsession with personal friendship to his responsibility for the people of the world. He is no longer just the prince who avenges his brothers, but also the general who cares about the common people and aspires to peace and prosperity; the lone sword in his hand is no longer just a weapon for revenge, but also a symbol of protecting the country and stabilizing the world.
The appearance of Mei Changsu was a turning point in Xiao Yan's destiny and the beginning of his transformation from "General Xiao Yan" to "Emperor Xiao Yan". When the sickly and resourceful counselor appeared in front of him and offered to assist him in seizing the heir, Xiao Yan smiled. In that smile, there was unconfidence in himself, disappointment in the court, and wariness of Mei Changsu. He detested the intrigues in the court and disdained the machinations of power. Even though he longed to avenge his grievances and seek justice for his brothers, he was unwilling to use despicable means. As a result, his relationship with Mei Changsu seesawed repeatedly in doubts and temptations - he wanted to use Mei Changsu's wisdom, but was disgusted with his every step of calculation; he was grateful for Mei Changsu's help, but also wary of his purpose.
When Princess Nihuang was framed by Concubine Yue, he immediately suspected that it was Mei Changsu's plan. He angrily rebuked Mei Changsu for not understanding the passion of the military and forcefully demanded that the other party set a rule not to harm Zhongliang; in the Wei Zheng incident, he Mistaking the slander and believing that Mei Changsu would sacrifice Chi Yan's old men to achieve great things, he actually cut off the palace bell that represents mutual trust with a sword, angrily accused Mei Changsu of having no nature and conscience, and completely ignored the pleading of Mei Changsu, who was seriously ill. This integrity and stubbornness, this purity that is not corrupted by power, are what distinguishes him from other princes, and it is also the original intention that Mei Changsu values. But after all, he did not understand that in this treacherous court, being alone and brave could not bring justice. Only by holding power can we bring order to the chaos and vindicate the grievances of the Red Flame Army.
The incident at Jiu'an Mountain became an opportunity for Xiao Yan to completely wake up. King Yu rebelled, and the hunting palace was besieged. At the critical moment of life and death, Xiao Yan successfully obtained the military talisman and led his army to help. He is still the general who leads the army, and he is still the brave and fearless man., the lone sword in his hand was unsheathed again, and he fought bravely among the chaotic army to protect the safety of Emperor Liang and everyone. After putting down the rebellion, he did not hesitate at all and immediately returned the military talisman to Emperor Liang. This magnanimity made even the always suspicious Emperor Liang hesitate. What shocked him even more was that during this rebellion, he finally confirmed that the frail counselor in front of him was his best friend whom he had missed for twelve years - Lin Shu.
At that moment, this strong-willed man completely collapsed. He returned to Zhiluo Palace, knelt down at the knees of his mother, Concubine Jing, and cried bitterly: "I almost recognized him, I should have recognized him." He felt sorry for Lin Shu's suffering in the past twelve years, and how he had transformed from a young general in bright clothes and angry horses to a sickly strategist; he felt deeply guilty for his misunderstandings, and for the repeated rebuke and hurt he had received. This belated recognition allowed him to let go of the obsession in his heart, and also allowed him to fully understand Mei Changsu's every step of the way - those seemingly cold calculations were never for power, but for Chi Yan's thousands of innocent souls, and for Daliang's thousands of miles of rivers and mountains.
From then on, Xiao Yan was no longer alone. He fought side by side with Mei Changsu, integrating his personal emotions into the great cause of clearing up the unjust case and reviving Chao Gang. He put aside his prejudice against "calculation", learned to weigh the pros and cons, and learned to be forbearing and restrained. He was no longer the general who only knew how to fight, but gradually grew into a prince with the world in mind and strategizing. He recruited talented people, reused talented people such as Shen Zhui and Cai Quan, straightened the government, and reformed bad governance; he appeased the people, reduced taxes, and sympathized with the people's sufferings, so that the displaced people could live and work in peace and contentment; he rectified military discipline and reorganized the Changlin Army to rejuvenate the Liang army and guard the tranquility of the border.
Above the court, he confronts Xia Jiang, Xie Yu and other treacherous ministers. The "lone sword" in his hand is no longer a sharp blade on the sand, but a symbol of fairness and justice. With the tenacity and courage he had learned during the twelve years of fighting in Shaqi, and with the wisdom and strategies taught by Mei Changsu, he uncovered the conspiracy of the Xuanjing Division step by step, and revealed the truth of Chi Yan's unjust case step by step, so that those treacherous ministers who had committed many evil deeds would get the punishment they deserve. He is not afraid of imperial power or threats. Even in the face of Emperor Liang's wrath and obstruction, he always sticks to his original intention and refuses to give in even half a step - he wants to avenge his brother Qi Wang, he wants to abdicate the snow for the 70,000 Red Flame Army, and he wants to keep a clear and bright court for the people of the world.
At the birthday banquet, Xiao Yan and Mei Changsu worked together, and with the help of Princess Liyang, they publicly revealed the entire truth about Chi Yan's unjust case. When the evidence of the crime that had been sealed for twelve years was made public, when the grievances of the 70,000 Red Flame Army were redressed, and Brother Qi Wang's innocence was proven, the court was in an uproar, and the people wept bitterly and were extremely grateful. At that moment, Xiao Yan stood in the court hall, with a tall and straight posture and a firm gaze. He finally completed his twelve years of obsession and finally comforted thousands of loyal souls in heaven. And he also completely won the recognition of everyone in the court and became the crown prince who was popular and expected by the people.
Soon after, Emperor Liang abdicated and Xiao Yan ascended the throne as emperor, known as Emperor Wu Jing in history. On the day he ascended the throne, he was wearing a dragon robe and a crown. He stood at the top of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, looking at the ministers kneeling below and looking at the thousands of miles of mountains and rivers. There was no joy in his heart, only a heavy responsibility. He thought of the life-and-death showdown on the sand moraine, of Mei Changsu's deep friendship, of Brother Qi Wang's ardent expectations, of the injustice of the 70,000 Red Flame Army, and of the suffering of the people at the border. He knew that the burden on his shoulders was heavier than ever before - he had to protect the country thousands of miles away, fulfill the unfinished wishes of Mei Changsu and Brother Qi, make Daliang prosperous, and make the people all over the world live and work in peace and contentment.
After ascending the throne, Xiao Yan worked hard to govern, work diligently and love the people. He followed King Qi's philosophy of governing the country, reformed bad government, rectified official administration,He valued the virtuous and severely punished the treacherous; he strengthened border defense, reorganized the Changlin Army, and appointed loyal and brave men such as Meng Zhi and Wei Zheng to guard the peace of Daliang's border, so that there would no longer be wars in the sand moraine, so that the people on the border could live and work in peace and contentment; he sympathized with the people, reduced taxes, built water conservancy projects, and encouraged farming, making Daliang's national power stronger and the people's lives increasingly prosperous. He always remembers his oath on the sand, always remembers his original intention, and always treats the people of the world and his country with an innocent heart.
As time goes by, the iron-blooded general on the sand moraine has now become a wise emperor. His eyebrows and eyes were a little less youthful, and a little more emperor's calmness and responsibility; a little less grief and obsession, and a little more generous and calm. But the courage and sincerity in his heart have never changed; the "lone sword" in his hand is still a symbol of protecting justice and stabilizing the world - but this sword is no longer stained with blood, but has become a good way to govern the country and a barrier to protect the people.
The wind is still the same, the yellow sand is still the same, but above the sand moraine, there is no longer the life and death fight of the past, only peace and harmony remain. Xiao Yan would occasionally come to the border sand moraine alone, holding a long sword and looking at the yellow sand in the sky and the thousands of miles of mountains and rivers. He seemed to see himself fighting bloody battles back then, saw Mei Changsu walking towards him with a smile, saw the gentle brows of Brother Qi Wang, and saw the orderly formation of the 70,000 Red Flame Army. At that moment, he finally understood that "Sha Qi determines life and death, and a solitary sword determines the world" has never been a slogan, but a portrayal of his half-life and his lifelong persistence.
He used the sand as a temper, life and death as a test, a lone sword as a support, and an innocent child as his original intention. He grew from an exiled prince to a wise emperor; from guarding a friendship to guarding thousands of miles of mountains and rivers; from clearing up an injustice to stabilizing the world. Xiao Yan's life was a life of loneliness, perseverance, and responsibility. He used his own life to explain what "innocent heart" is, what "feelings for family and country" are, and what "a sand ridge determines life and death, and a solitary sword determines the world."
Thousands of years later, when people talk about the wise emperors of Daliang and that magnificent history, they will always think of the brave and loyal man standing on the sand moraine with his lone sword on the ground - Xiao Yan. His story will shine forever like the stars above the sand moraine; his spirit will be spread forever like the long wind at the border; his original intention will be forever firm like the lone sword in his hand. Sha Qi is silent, witnessing his life, death and perseverance; the years are silent, remembering his responsibility and legend. Xiao Yan went on the mission with solitude and courage, and determined the country with iron and blood. He lived up to his youth, his original intention, the world, and thousands of loyal souls. He eventually became a legend and will be recorded in history forever.
